en.p: For a real number $k>1$, let $\mathrm{A}$ be the intersection point of the two curves

and let $\mathrm{B}$ be the point where the line through $\mathrm{A}$ with slope $-1$ meets the curve $y=2^{x-2}-3$. When the area of triangle $\mathrm{AOB}$ is $16$, $k+\log_{2}k=\dfrac{q}{p}$. Find the value of $p+q$. (Here $\mathrm{O}$ is the origin, and $p$ and $q$ are relatively prime natural numbers.) [4 points]
